verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is a government intellectual-property office whose portal handles filings for patents, trademarks, and designs. User-built automations with versioning, review, and rollback fall outside what this kind of product would offer. Provisions for amending, dividing, or withdrawing applications (e.g., amendments to a registration request, substituting design elements, withdrawals) concern legal filings, not automations, so they do not make this axis applicable.
